---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case
Explain how this feature would benefit MPOs or project applicants.

**Example scenario:**
"As a [role], I want to [action] so that [benefit]."

## Proposed Solution
How do you envision this feature working?

## Alternative Approaches
Have you considered any alternative solutions or features?

## Analysis Method (if applicable)
If requesting a new analysis method:
- **Geometry type:** [Point/LineString/Polygon]
- **What it would measure:** [e.g., "density of features within buffer"]
- **Sample output:** [e.g., "15 features per square mile"]

## Configuration Example (if applicable)
Show how you'd expect to configure this in `datasets.yaml` or `config.yaml`:

```yaml
# Your proposed configuration
```

## MPO Context
- **Your MPO:** [Optional - helps us understand real-world needs]
- **Plan type:** [e.g., RTP, TIP, Safety Action Plan]
- **Frequency of use:** [e.g., once per cycle, monthly, daily]

## Additional Context
Any other context, screenshots, or examples.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have checked existing issues and discussions
- [ ] This feature aligns with the tool's client-side architecture
- [ ] I have provided a real-world use case
